# SQLite 3.54.1

Unmodified `sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` from the official amalgamation:
https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip

Archive SHA3-256, verified before extraction:
`92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`

SQLite's authors dedicate the deliverable library to the public domain:
https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html
The original notices remain in both files. No SQLite build scripts or shell are
included. SubCard compiles this C source into a static archive for each frontend.
The platform's SQLite dynamic library is not used for document operations.
